title: CodeGapQA: Hardware-Oriented HCS-Inspired QPU Certification
description: Public source code, sanitized confirmatory QASM, aggregate certificate metrics, tests, and manuscript for a 60-qubit hardware-oriented HCS-inspired local-witness certification experiment. Related preprint: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21724982.
notes: The source code is Apache-2.0. The paper, figures, public QASM, and public data are CC BY 4.0. Preprint not peer reviewed. Related preprint DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21724982.
